name: Neural Mixture of Planar Experts (NeurMiPs)
definition: A planar-based scene representation for modeling geometry and appearance that leverages a collection of local planar experts in 3D space. Each expert consists of parameters for a local rectangular shape (geometry) and a neural radiance field (appearance).
summary: NeurMiPs is a sample-efficient scene representation using local planar experts that offers faster rendering and lower memory usage than volume-based methods.
